ruleset: Standard international (Western) chess — kings, queens, bishops, rooks, knights and pawns; castling, en passant, promotion, checkmate and draw rules. Not Thai chess (Makruk); Thai is only an interface language.

session.note: Wall-clock time from the OpenCode session's creation to the final capture. The app, repository, CI workflow and live GitHub Pages deployment were already complete and verified at capture time. The state file and its commit were written immediately after.

usage.note: Read from the OpenCode session database. totalTokens sums all five counters, including cache reads; cache reads are repeated prompt context and dominate the figure. costUSD is 0 on the flat-rate plan.

verification.method: Node verification suite plus headless Chrome over the DevTools Protocol
checks: En passant, castling (king and rook placement), all four promotions

EN/TH switch across controls, inspector, coach and puzzle content
localStorage reload restores moves, clocks, language and puzzle progress
390 x 844 mobile viewport: no horizontal overflow
